import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf

# 1. Load datasets and flag success
df_pos = pd.read_parquet('train.parquet')
df_neg = pd.read_parquet('train_neg.parquet')
df_pos['success'] = 1
df_neg['success'] = 0

df = pd.concat([df_pos, df_neg], ignore_index=True)

# 2. Drop rows with null or zero MW_delta and compute ratio
df = df[df['MW_delta'].notnull() & (df['MW_delta'] != 0)]
df['ratio'] = df['QED_delta'] / df['MW_delta']

# 3. Summary statistics of ratio by success/failure
ratio_stats = df.groupby('success')['ratio'].describe()
print("Summary statistics of QED_delta/MW_delta ratio by success flag:")
print(ratio_stats)

# 4. Distribution plots (histogram + KDE)
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.histplot(data=df, x='ratio', hue='success', stat='density', common_norm=False,
             bins=50, kde=True, palette=['tab:orange','tab:blue'])
plt.xlabel('QED_delta / MW_delta')
plt.ylabel('Density')
plt.title('Distribution of QED_delta/MW_delta by Success (1) vs Failure (0)')
plt.legend(title='Success', labels=['Failure (0)', 'Success (1)'])
plt.show()

# 5. Mann-Whitney U test
ratios_succ = df.loc[df['success'] == 1, 'ratio']
ratios_fail = df.loc[df['success'] == 0, 'ratio']
u_stat, p_val = mannwhitneyu(ratios_succ, ratios_fail, alternative='two-sided')
print(f"Mann-Whitney U test: U = {u_stat:.2f}, p-value = {p_val:.4g}")

# 6. Logistic regression: success ~ ratio + C(task_id)
model = smf.logit('success ~ ratio + C(task_id)', data=df).fit(disp=False)
print(model.summary())

# 7. Plot predicted success probability vs ratio for most common task_id
common_task = df['task_id'].mode()[0]
ratio_min, ratio_max = df['ratio'].quantile([0.01, 0.99])
ratio_vals = np.linspace(ratio_min, ratio_max, 100)
pred_df = pd.DataFrame({'ratio': ratio_vals, 'task_id': common_task})
pred_df['success_prob'] = model.predict(pred_df)

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
plt.plot(ratio_vals, pred_df['success_prob'], color='tab:green')
plt.xlabel('QED_delta / MW_delta')
plt.ylabel('Predicted Success Probability')
plt.title(f'Predicted Success Probability vs Ratio (task_id={common_task})')
plt.ylim(0, 1)
plt.show()
